import numpy as np


def create_logits(x1, x2, logit_scale):
    x1 = x1 / x1.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    x2 = x2 / x2.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)

    logits_per_x1 = logit_scale * x1 @ x2.t()
    logits_per_x2 = logits_per_x1.t()

    return logits_per_x1, logits_per_x2
